► DLC - Restream. The part related to creating tasks to start the server has been reworked. Now the program itself asks for permissions.

► #Twitch - the list of viewers has been fixed. Channel points have been reworked according to the new API.
► #DonatePay – fixed connection error.

► #Youtube – reworked search and connection to broadcasts. The program automatically searches for ~15 minutes active broadcasts. Now it is possible to connect to several broadcasts.

Fixed a bug that did not allow you to select a bot preset activated when drawing the winner.

⚙️ Other:
Multiple minor changes and optimizations.

notes.title: Alpha 4.0
notes.content:
Completely rewritten program basis. General optimization and maintenance to order settings. The base is prepared to redesign the program. The engine now supports switching modules on the fly, allowing you to not restart the program, resulting in falls and possible data loss. The new engine allows you to connect multiple channels from a single stream platform (as long as it is not available due to lack of redesign).

Please, check setting after update.

Unfortunately, the redesign will be later. And it will be added as they become available.

[list]
[*] If you save the program settings are not reset, all settings can be changed on the fly
[*] Themes
[olist]
    [*] Setting message display time deleted

For example, a theme designer has determined that it is possible to move the color change messages, font size, and method of the animation number of messages, etc.
[*] Changing themes on the move (the program remembers poslenie 4 posts for clarity)
[/olist]

   [*] Setting List of selected viewers ignore list are removed and are enabled by default
   [*] Setting Display posts about changing the current track

[*] Time Support streamers (Twitch, Goodgame)
[*] Settings conversion time, the number of messages in loans
[*] Setting issuance ranks in order and set of conditions or the issuance of individual terms is of the order of
[/olist]

[*] The pause between the teams.

[*] The winner of the draw

[*] Now the bot supports 2 types of scripts: LUA and C #. Just at the script, you can specify a parameter that can take into account the features of the script.
[*] Boat is able to give out grades
[*] Accrual loans
[*] Call preset remote control
[/olist]
   [*] Alerts
[olist]
[*] Added option to pause for alerts (alerts will come, displayed in the log and chat, but the visual part will be played after the removal of the pause)
[*] Added function to reset the notification queue
[*] Added option of removing references notifications (they are only displayed in the log, is enabled by default)
[*] Settings are now transferred automatically to the notification, no longer need to add them separately in the program stream
[/olist]
[*]Remote control
[olist]
[*] Added script call option (supports C # scripts)
[*] Added option to execute a bot team
Added an option to work with a tag timer (start, reset, it remains [*] ovit if he ran out to call another preset Remote Control)
[/olist]
   [*] Tags
[olist]
[*] Added 5 predefined tags timers
[*] Added support for custom labels. The user can create a new label, assign it the C # script that will be called by the timer
[/olist]
   [*] Workshop. Fixed an issue where the meta file incorrectly handles these files in it
   [*] Log alerts. If you delete and add data they affect [*] Data Collection
   [*] Clearing the cache Setting smiles, now also clears your browser cache
   [*] Added additional checks during the transition in Game Mode, which should eliminate the fall
   [*] Added support site DonatePay
   [*] Cybergame. Highlighting the tape drive posts
   [*]Data collection. Fixed stroke limit and the collected amount. [*] Fixed a bug due to which at the start of the program data collection can be empty
   [*] Hitbox. Added reconnection
   [*] Youtube. Added support for attributes moderators
   [*] Vkontakte. Added support for the translation of the profile (previously supported only in the group). Bug fixes for connecting to the newly created translation
   [*] Twitch. Fixed interception of auto host
[/list]

Just ask the indulgence, because this version of the transition, a very large volume of work has been done. Although external changes is small enough. All of these changes is primarily to adapt to Steam, that would be the program was the most autonomous, and new users had fewer worries.

[*]The program is completely moved on Steam. Updates to the current version is stim in the near future is not planned! The same version is Steam, probation shall not be granted because the principle of the different versions can kordinalno!

[*]Youtube. Completely redesigned chat support. Now the service is connected through the API. To work is not required to specify a particular broadcast Id is taken automatically found the first broadcast (conditionally Youtube, broadcast sorts - first that should go right now, but as in the API mess, possible incidents, so watch any broadcast in the list above). Temporarily out of moderation because there is no per se in the API. Fixed output custom emoticons. Added check for recurring subscription.
[*]Twitch. Fixed authorization requests are now followers and spectators counter are displayed correctly. Fixed output Emoji. Added check for recurring subscription.
[*]VIDI. Added counter spectators on the player.
[*]Fixed output icons in the skins sites, if your theme icons, no longer need to choose the exact same topic.
[*]Alerts list. Fixed subscriber and re-subs.
[*]Designer alerts. Fixed site settings, now it works correctly. Added parameter {site_img}, which contains a site icon.
[*]Reworked saving window position that could cause program crash at startup, now these settings are saved where all settings.
[*]Vote. Fixed timer.
[*]Game Mode. Fixed output counters.
[*]Ranks. Added a warning in the event of data cleaning.
